task.title: Recover from malformed JSON
task.shortdesc: Diagnose malformed JSON syntax before saving, importing, or validating a policy document.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Malformed JSON is a syntax problem: BPM cannot parse the document far enough to validate policy names or values.

step.cmd: Keep the JSON editor or import error open so the line, column, or parse message remains visible.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Check the nearest braces, brackets, commas, quotation marks, and escaped characters around the reported location.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Format or validate the document again after the syntax correction.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Continue to schema validation only after the JSON parses successfully.

info.note: Retry only from the BPM interface; do not change profile data outside the application.

result.p: The document parses as JSON and can move to normal policy validation.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
